The 5-Layer Enterprise Agent Stack: Google Cloud Service and Open-Source Equivalent at Every Layer
Read top-down to follow a request; each chip pairs the managed Google service with the open-source project you can self-host.
Where humans see results, approve risky writes, and watch budgets — identical UX on either stack.
Deterministic guards around the LLM; the same controls exist in ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen.
Right model per step, only the Top-3 tools per step, sanitized in and out.

Rule of thumb: pick the managed service when you want the SLA, the open-source twin when you need portability — the guarantees per layer must not change.
